title: Dynamic multimodal cation-carbon interaction for efficient adiponitrile electrosynthesis
title_zh: 动态多模态阳离子-碳相互作用实现高效己二腈电合成
abstract: Adiponitrile electrosynthesis from acrylonitrile hydrodimerization is critical for the nylon industry. However, the key step of single-electron acrylonitrile reduction demands toxic heavy-metal electrodes and leads to low energy efficiency. We developed a dynamic multimodal cation-electrode interaction strategy to enable efficient synthesis with environmentally friendly carbon electrodes. Optimal benzyltrihexylammonium cations create a water-depleted interface in aqueous electrolytes by squeezing the electric double layer through multimodal noncovalent interactions between the benzyl moieties of the cations and carbon electrodes. This strategy achieves selectivity comparable to the standard lead-based system but at substantially lower overpotentials, as demonstrated from the laboratory scale to a 159–square centimeter electrolyzer. This work underscores the importance of tailoring cation-centered microenvironments for sustainable, industrial organic electrosynthesis in more conductive aqueous systems.
abstract_zh: 从丙烯腈的水相二聚电化学合成己二腈是尼龙工业的关键步骤。然而，单电子还原丙烯腈的关键步骤需要有毒的重金属电极，导致能效低下。我们开发了一种动态多模态阳离子-电极相互作用策略，利用环保的碳电极实现高效合成。最优的苯甲基三己基铵阳离子通过阳离子苯甲基与碳电极之间的多模态非共价相互作用，压缩电双层，形成水分子缺乏的界面，从而在水相电解质中实现高选择性。该策略在实验室规模到159 cm²电解槽的放大过程中，表现出与传统铅基系统相当的选择性，但显著降低了过电位。此工作强调了为可持续、工业级有机电合成在更导电的水相体系中定制阳离子中心微环境的重要性。
